theorems.name: BP_E2_CRYPTO_PUBLIC_POLICY
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding stackpointer ra p q n m rp xp ordinary s a.
    bp_e2_crypto_public_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding stackpointer ra p q
    n
    m
    rp
    xp
    ordinary
    (s,a)
    ==> assurance_checked_run (bp_assurance_call_steps n)
        (bp_assurance_call_post 270800960 stackpointer ra p q n
         (read events s)
         m
        s)
        (assurance_zero_scalar_step
         (bp_e2_crypto_allowed_read rp ordinary p q n stackpointer)
         bp_e2_crypto_allowed_write
        (bp_e2_crypto_allowed_fetch xp ordinary 270800960))
        s
